sections: Header Navigation (Logo, Solutions, Methodology, Packages, Sample Report, Testimonials, FAQ, Portal Login CTA)

Methodology (The SilentCX 4-Pillar Framework: Discrete Inspection, Rigorous SOP Benchmark, Empirical Evidence, Actionable Remediation)
Core Services Bento (Mystery Shopping, CX Audit, SOP Compliance, Multi-Outlet Benchmark, Competitor Intel, Re-Audit)
Target Industries (F&B/Dining, Luxury Retail, Hospitality, Wellness & Clinics, Automotive, Multi-Outlet Franchises)

primary_views: Overview (Summary KPIs, Average CX Score, Severity Breakdown, Recent Audits, Top Remediation Priorities)
Audits & Visits (List with filter by outlet/date/status, detailed audit timeline, visit evidence)
Outlets Benchmarking (Multi-outlet score comparison, leaderboards, regional variance)

admin_dashboard_desktop_first.navigation_density: High density, sidebar collapsible, quick filter search
views: Admin Cockpit (Action-required items: Pending Shopper approvals, QA Report sign-offs, Disputed visits)

Shopper Pool & KYC Verification (Background check, reliability score, payout approvals)
Client Accounts & Outlets (Company directory, multi-branch hierarchies, package allocations)
Report QA & Publishing Suite (Review shopper submissions, edit recommendations, publish interactive client report)
Revenue & Billing (Invoices, package sales, platform commission)
CMS & System Configuration (Manage testimonials, case studies, FAQ, audit logs)

components: Executive Header (Brand, Branch, Date, Mystery Shopper ID, Overall CX Score with circular dial)
CX Scorecard (Overall + 5 Sub-categories: Greeting & First Impression, Staff Knowledge, Service Speed, Cleanliness & SOP, Checkout & Departure)
Customer Journey Map (Interactive chronological touchpoints with sentiment curve)
SOP Compliance Checklist (Passed, Deviations, Failure points)
Key Findings by Severity (Badges: Critical, High, Medium, Low with photographic evidence attachments)
Consultant Action Plan (Immediate Quick Wins, 30-Day Process Upgrades, 90-Day Training Needs)

testing_attributes_contract.rule: Every button, input, tab, card, badge, and navigation item MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all source files as .js or .jsx (standard React CRA/craco environment).
2. Maintain the Deep Charcoal (#06080C, #0D1117, #151B23) and Metallic Golden Yellow (#E5A93C) brand identity for public & executive surfaces.
3. Provide seamless role switching or direct login options for ADMIN, CLIENT, and MYSTERY SHOPPER with pre-filled demo accounts for frictionless evaluation.
4. Ensure Shopper Dashboard provides an authentic mobile-first layout (centered device frame or adaptive mobile controls) so secret shoppers can complete audits on phones.
5. Ensure Admin Dashboard allows rapid review of audits, approval of mystery shoppers, managing packages, and editing reports.
6. Include the 9-Step Onboarding Wizard with step indicators, package selection, and summary checkout.
7. Include the interactive CX Audit Report with score breakdowns, SOP failure points, photo evidence, and printable/PDF export capabilities.
8. Use Lucide icons consistently throughout, avoiding emojis or cartoonish icons.
9. Always include data-testid on every interactive element.
